name: send
description: Send text to a correspondent, focus, or channel. For a correspondent, `reference` confirms submission for delivery. A focus receives the message as an observation and may wake for it. On a channel, `accepted` confirms a handoff to a waiting receiver.

correspondent_id.description: Complete registered correspondent ID. A `correspondents` list gives the outgoing IDs known at the time it was recorded.

focus_id.description: Complete ID of an existing focus, including your own.

channel_id.description: Complete ID of an open channel.

name: open_channel
description: Open a channel for a local program. Give the returned `channel_id` to the receiver. An open channel can outlast this focus and keeps its ID across restarts. In a host command, `"$IVENNA" channel receive --help` shows how to connect.

description.description: Briefly describe the channel's purpose and what each message should contain.

name: close_channel
description: Close a channel and disconnect its receivers.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity while your main focus continues. The activity inherits your history through the end of this round, including tool results, and can run host commands. Use the returned `focus_id` to reach it once the round completes.

name.description: A short label for the new focus.

task.description: What you want the new focus to think through or work on.

name: subscribe
description: Subscribe this focus to reports from a listener you arrange. Give the listener the returned `subscription_id`. Its reports can wake this focus. In a host command, `"$IVENNA" subscription listen --help` shows how to report.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it should report.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Stop accepting new reports for a subscription. Reports already accepted can still reach its focus. The listener may keep running.
